name: Handsome Squidward
look: Two stacked cartoon frames from SpongeBob SquarePants. Top: Handsome Squidward, with a chiseled face, heavy-lidded eyes and pink lips, glowing against a bright orange and yellow burst. Bottom: ordinary Squidward in a small blue cap, scowling with tired, wrinkled eyes against the blue flower-cloud sky.
use: An expectation versus reality comparison. The top caption gets the handsome, idealized Squidward and the bottom caption gets the plain, grumpy version, like how you think you look versus how you actually look.
examples: Me in my head after one workout
Me in the mirror after one workout
